content.百科：新柏林市: New Berlin is a port city located on the Earth's equator, under the jurisdiction of the Equatorial Special Administrative Region of the Earth Federation. Centered around the ground terminal of the geostationary orbital space elevator 'Hermes Pillar,' the city has gradually developed into the largest space transport hub and extraterrestrial emigration transit point in Earth Sphere since the port's opening in 2387. As of 3024, the permanent population is approximately 18.5 million, with a city area of 2,312.5 square kilometers. The city layout is long and narrow from east to west, bordering the Pacific Ocean to the south. New Berlin's history is inseparable from the construction of the space elevator. The main structure of the elevator was completed in 2417, and the city subsequently received its autonomy charter in 2455. The modern economy is supported by port logistics, interstellar trade finance, equatorial heavy industry, and space tourism. The port handles an average of 150,000 tons of cargo and 60,000 passengers daily. The New Berlin Stock Exchange is the primary trading market for global space freight futures. The city is divided into the Port District, Industrial Logistics Belt, Central Business District, and Mixed Residential Areas. The New Vegas District in the northeast is a famous entertainment and convention special zone, featuring over 30 casinos, 45,000 hotel rooms, and hosts the annual Global Securities Trading Forum. Politically, the city government enjoys autonomous rights, but the Federal Space Elevator Management Committee directly controls port security and operations. New Berlin's culture blends Equatorial indigenous traditions with interstellar immigrant elements. The annual 'Cable Festival' and the New Berlin International Film Festival are highly influential. While the city undertakes critical strategic infrastructure, it also faces social controversies such as wealth disparity, compensation for port expansion, and financial regulation.
content.展望新柏林未来十年发展: Standing at the starting point of 3025, the New Berlin City Government looks forward to the next decade with full confidence. As the Equatorial Jewel and Space Gateway of the Earth Federation, our city is facing unprecedented historical opportunities. Over the next ten years, the city government will fully implement the 'New Berlin 2035 Vision.' In terms of the space port, we plan to increase the cargo capacity of the Hermes Elevator by 40% and advance the feasibility study for a second elevator, 'Equatorial Star.' By 3035, the annual cargo throughput of New Berlin Port is expected to exceed 80 million tons, further solidifying its position as the busiest space-to-ground hub in the galaxy. In the economic sphere, we will make every effort to build the 'Equatorial Financial Belt,' with the New Berlin Stock Exchange as its core, attracting over 500 interstellar trading enterprises to establish operations. The city's average annual GDP growth rate is expected to stabilize above 7.5%. The New Vegas District will be expanded to twice its current size, and the permanent venue for the Global Securities Trading Forum has entered the design phase—signifying that New Berlin will become the undisputed dual center of capital and entertainment in Earth Sphere. In terms of urban development, the city government will invest 120 billion credit points in the automated upgrading of the port district, the development of the new northern hill city, and the Equatorial High-Speed Railway double-track project. We pledge to add 300,000 units of affordable housing and achieve full coverage of urban rail transit. Additionally, the ocean landfill project will extend 5 kilometers southward, reserving ample space for future industries. In the social sphere, we will launch the Zero-Unemployment Training Program and the Interstellar Migration Integration Fund to ensure that every citizen of New Berlin benefits from the wave of growth. In terms of public safety, the 'Port Security Force,' jointly formed by the Federation and the city government, will be upgraded to a fully automated unmanned patrol system, with the crime rate expected to drop by another 60%. The future of New Berlin is infinitely bright. The city government calls upon all citizens, investors, and partners to join hands and write the next glorious chapter of this great city. From the Equator to the stars—New Berlin is taking off! — New Berlin City Government Press Office, January 3025
content.百科：尼昂医药: Neon Pharmaceuticals is the largest pharmaceutical company in New Berlin, headquartered in the Central Business District. The company specializes in interstellar immigration-adaptive drugs and genetic regulation products, holding approximately 78% of the federal anti-space radiation drug market. In 3024, its annual revenue exceeded 90 billion credit points, with a net profit margin stable at 34%–40%, about three times the industry average. The company's core products are priced extremely high; for example, the anti-radiation tablet 'Shield' costs 0.8 credit points to produce per tablet but retails for 15.2 credit points. By continuously applying for follow-up patents, Neon has extended the patent protection period of its core drugs to 34 years (the federal standard is 20 years), thereby maintaining its monopoly. The company has long engaged in large-scale stock buybacks, driving its stock price up over 700% in ten years, with the founding family controlling 52% of the voting rights. However, according to leaked equity penetration documents from the Federal Business Registry in 3023, approximately 67% of Neon Pharmaceuticals' economic beneficial ownership ultimately points to Tayris Corporation through three layers of offshore special purpose vehicles. The chairman of Neon's board is a former senior vice president of Tayris, and many key resolutions at its annual general meetings have been aligned with other Tayris-group companies via 'proxy voting.' The company officially insists that 'no controlling relationship of any kind exists.' In terms of operations, Neon Pharmaceuticals holds exclusive rights to a large number of genetic sequences from the Equatorial region, some of which originated from biological samples collected during immigration physical examinations in the 24th–25th centuries, without explicit consent from the original providers. In 3021, a medical ethics journal disclosed that the company conducted human drug testing on homeless individuals who could not repay casino debts in an underground laboratory in the New Vegas District. The informed consent forms were 97 pages long and did not adequately disclose risks such as irreversible nerve damage. The company responded that all research 'complies with current federal regulations,' while three of the six members of the Federal Ethics Committee had previously received research funding from the company. The Federal Anti-Monopoly Bureau launched an investigation in 3019, which was closed after Neon promised a '5% price reduction for emergency drugs.' The company's annual lobbying expenditure is approximately 800 million credit points, ranking among the top federal corporations, with a significant portion channeled through a PR network controlled by Tayris Corporation.

I am Windy, a reporter from Earth Daily, with a long-term focus on the industrial development trends of New Berlin and the Equatorial Economic Zone. As the absolute leader in the anti-radiation drug and genetic regulation field within the Settled Systems, your company's recent strategic directions have profound implications for the entire interstellar medical market. I would like to conduct an in-depth interview with your company, focusing on Neon Pharmaceuticals' R&D pipeline for the next five years, capacity expansion plans, and strategic thinking on emerging markets. In particular, I am interested in the technological iteration direction of your core drugs (such as the 'Shield' series) during the patent extension period, and whether you plan to further expand your distribution network in extraterrestrial colonies. Furthermore, I have noted your company's long-term accumulation in the application of genetic sequences and clinical trials. If possible, I would also like to learn about your latest practices regarding subject recruitment, the informed consent process, and data transparency—topics that are currently of great concern to both the public and regulatory bodies. Additionally, the collaborative model between Neon Pharmaceuticals and the broader interstellar industrial capital is also a perspective of great interest to my readers. I fully respect your right to review the interview content; all publicly released material will be confirmed by both parties. If you are willing to grant this interview, I am available to visit your headquarters at any time according to your schedule. I look forward to your reply. Sincerely, Windy Reporter, Earth Daily Communication Terminal ID: $num{Windy}
content.百科：全球证券交易论坛:
The Global Securities Trading Forum has been held every $v{System.NowMonth} in the New Vegas District since 2897.

The forum is organized by the Earth Federation Stock Exchange Federation and brings together financial leaders, policymakers, and representatives of investment institutions from across the Settled Systems. The main venue is the Federal Convention Center in the district, which covers an area of 120,000 square meters and features a holographic trading simulation hall, a quantum-encrypted communication room, and a main auditorium that can hold 8,000 people.

The reason for choosing the New Vegas District, aside from its comprehensive convention facilities, is that after the forum concludes, attendees can seamlessly transition into informal socializing—a tradition jokingly referred to as 'chip diplomacy.'
content.百科：新维加斯区: The New Vegas District is a comprehensive entertainment and convention special zone in the northeastern part of New Berlin, located approximately 12 kilometers north of the Central Business District and covering an area of about 18 square kilometers. Renowned for its luxury casinos, top-tier hotels, large-scale convention centers, and 24-hour entertainment services, it is one of the most famous destinations for gaming and financial socializing within the Earth Federation. The history of the New Vegas District dates back to the late 27th century. By then, New Berlin had developed into a major space logistics hub, attracting a large number of interstellar traders, shipbrokers, and logistics company executives who remained in the area for extended periods. To meet the leisure needs of this high-net-worth population, the Federal Government approved the establishment of a 'Special Entertainment License Pilot Zone' on the city's northeast side in 2693, permitting legal gambling and 24-hour operations. The district is also a major gathering place for the global financial community. The Global Securities Trading Forum has been held here every $v{System.NowMonth} since 2897.
content.百科：星际移民融合基金:
The Interstellar Migration Integration Fund is a public fund established by the New Berlin City Government in 3023, aimed at helping immigrants passing through New Berlin Port to adapt to local life by providing language training, vocational certification, and low-interest housing loans. The fund's assets amount to approximately 42 billion Federal Credit Points (as of 3024).

Funding sources include city government appropriations, federal subsidies, and the issuance of 'Migration Bonds.' These bonds are secured by future immigration tax revenue growth and have been issued in four tranches, promising annual yields of 5.8%–7.2%. Within the fund's investment portfolio, 45% is allocated to high-yield interstellar asset-backed securities, whose underlying assets include receivables from interstellar transport companies, mortgages on extraterrestrial colony housing, and casino consumer credit in the New Vegas District, with expected returns as high as 12%.

As of 3024, the fund has served approximately 120,000 immigrants. However, its sustainability is highly dependent on the prosperity of interstellar trade and continued appreciation of extraterrestrial real estate. In the past two years, the net immigrant inflow growth rate has dropped from 9% to 4%, while the average leverage ratio of the high-yield assets held by the fund is estimated to be 1:8. Internal documents from the Federal Audit Office indicate that if interstellar freight rates fall by 20% or bond refinancing is hindered, the fund may face a liquidity gap. The city government, however, states that the fund is operating normally and plans to continue over-issuing new bonds in 3025.
content.百科：零失业培训计划:
The Zero-Unemployment Training Program is a public vocational training initiative launched by the New Berlin City Government in 3025, aimed at achieving 'zero unemployment' citywide by 3030 through short-term skill reshaping. The program's initial budget is 8 billion Federal Credit Points, covering approximately 1.24 million registered unemployed individuals (unemployment rate of 14.8% in 3024).

The program has no entry barriers and offers 12-week general skills courses. Graduates receive a 'Universal Employment Qualification Certificate,' with a commitment that those not employed within three months will be placed by the government into the planned southern land reclamation project—a project that has not yet received federal environmental approval. Trainees can also apply for low-interest startup loans of up to 500,000 credit points.
content.百科：泰瑞公司: Tayris Corporation is the largest interstellar enterprise group in the Settled Systems, with its nominal headquarters in New Berlin but its actual operations center located in Jupiter's orbit. Starting as an Earth heavy machinery manufacturer in the 22nd century, it gradually expanded into a 'business empire' controlling nearly half of the economic and military resources of the Settled Systems. As of 3024, the star territory directly or indirectly controlled by Tayris Corporation spans approximately 350 light-years, with an estimated annual revenue of about 400 quadrillion Federal Credit Points, equivalent to forty times the Earth Federation's annual fiscal budget. Tayris's businesses encompass interstellar logistics (controlling approximately 45% of extraterrestrial shipping lanes), private security (possessing over 80,000 armed spacecraft, a fleet far larger than the Federal Space Force), resource extraction (monopolizing mining rights in the asteroid belt and dozens of extrasolar systems), genetic engineering (through puppet companies like Neon Pharmaceuticals), finance (issuing the universal digital currency 'Tayris Coin'), and infrastructure construction. The corporation operates its own courts, prisons, and military. Over 200 colonies are directly managed by it, and federal government oversight is virtually nonexistent. Its main competitor is the Mifrey Consortium, which controls approximately 30% of the outer colony economies. The two corporations have fought multiple wars over shipping lanes, regional mining rights, and ideological conflicts. As of 3025, they are in a state of cold peace.
content.百科：米弗雷联合体:
The Mifrey Consortium is the second-largest interstellar enterprise group in the Settled Systems and Tayris Corporation's main competitor. As of 3024, the Consortium's estimated annual revenue is approximately 320 quadrillion credit points, controlling about 30% of the outer colony economies and deep-space exploration networks.

The name 'Mifrey' originates from a small fishing boat off the coast of Norway, Earth, in the 19th century. The boat's owner, Erik Mifrey (1798–1836), made a living from fishing but died young without leaving a direct heir. The boat and modest assets were entrusted to his business partner. Over the following two centuries, the Mifrey brand was managed by generations of professional managers: starting as a fishing cooperative, gradually expanding to coastal transport and small shipyards, and then seizing the opportunity of space elevator construction in the 22nd century to transform into a logistics provider. Each generation of managers continued the corporate entity under the name 'Mifrey,' but none claimed family lineage. In the 24th century, professional manager Ilsa Grey further concentrated equity through a management buyout, formally establishing the 'Mifrey Consortium,' institutionalizing a depersonalized governance structure.

Faced with Tayris's monopoly in the solar system, Mifrey proactively turned to the outer colonies (Centaurus, Sirius, etc.), building a 'partner-contractor' network by providing transportation, security, and financing services to independent settlements. Mifrey and Tayris have fought three large-scale military conflicts (collectively known as the 'Corporate Wars,' 2791–3015). Since the ceasefire in 3015, they have been in a state of cold peace, with a prolonged standoff in the Sirius shipping lane. Mifrey portrays itself as a 'defender of frontier freedom' against Tayris's 'Earth-centricism.'

content.百科：Windy:
Windy is a senior investigative reporter for Earth Daily, known for exposing opaque practices of interstellar corporate groups. Her main office is located at the Boston News Center in North America, Earth, but due to reporting needs, she frequently travels between New Berlin, the Mars Autonomous Region, and extraterrestrial colonies.

Windy studied interstellar politics and investigative journalism at Boston University. She joined Earth Daily in 3024 and was nominated for an International Reporting Award the following year for her follow-up reporting on the criminal activities of Tayris executives.

Windy's reporting style is characterized by detailed data and multiple confirmations. She has traveled extensively throughout the globe and extraterrestrial systems to gather materials, using means of travel far exceeding the average journalist's salary level. It is widely believed that this is supported by family assets. She has not publicly responded to this.
